text: My office received a petition from a majority of residents to install additional speed bumps in the laneway east of Winners Circle, north of Boardwalk Drive.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of additional speed bumps in the north-south public lane east of Winners Circle, north of Boardwalk Drive, as shown on Drawing No. TC-106, dated November 2022, from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
